integrity: Proof is analytic with reproducible exact-rational polynomial checks; the checks do not replace the Poisson-process and coupling arguments. No independent audit or numerical validation is claimed.
limitations: Unit circle of circumference one, unit Poisson intensity and unit radial speed. Neither optimal seed placement, universal connected-group results nor an exact Haar expected cover time are established. Historical priority awaits independent literature review.
title: Haar nonoptimality on a connected circle for Poisson growing-ball coverage
